_note: Red in the combat sandbox (docs/pivot/combat_api.md 4.2 and 5). Times in ms or s as the key says, distances in metres. The numbers that Ross tunes live as feel knobs (data/combat/feel.json); 'knob_defaults' is only what Red uses if no knob panel is there.

dash._cooldown_note: RETIRED (Ross 2026-10-09, dash on charges): nothing reads cooldown_ms any more. Dash charges and the chain gap are the feel knobs dash_charges, dash_recharge_s and dash_chain_gap_s.

death._note: 'sandbox': at 0 health she gets up after a moment (the feel prototype). 'retry': she stays down and the room restarts her (the slice; ActionRoom sets this from data/slice/slice.json 'retry').

town._note: Town mode (the night market, no fighting; docs/slice/slice_tech_plan.md 3). The buttons listed do nothing there. The clip map turns the field clip names the town code uses (HeroLink.play_clip) into this model's clips.
